skills.name: Find and use a common denominator
skills.definition: Find an appropriate common denominator for unlike fraction denominators and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fraction parts with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Handle mixed and whole-number parts
skills.definition: Separate mixed or whole numbers into whole-number and fractional parts, subtract whole-number parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow from the whole number
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify or normalize the result
skills.definition: Reduce fractional results to lowest terms or normalize zero fractional results into integer form.
